name: Razer Basilisk V2
notes: 94-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface (interface 0) of a real Razer Basilisk V2, from the usb-hid-device-report-corpus dump of the device: https://github.com/steve-chamberlin/usb-hid-device-report-corpus/blob/37179eb6d8c61847c27a6def827a9dce39bf608d/mice/1532-0085 Razer Basilisk V2 gaming mouse.txt#L95-L100. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
